notes: Task status retrieval selects the exact operationID; it never resubmits the initiating mutation.
Gateway status APIs return collections whose published rows omit an exact gateway identity field; input edgeID alone cannot justify selecting the first row. No such waiter is invented.

LAN/link and dedicated-line status queries lack scalar port or line selection inputs. Access control rule queries do not accept rule IDs. These collections cannot safely supply per-resource readiness.

request_notes: Preserve nested JSON objects and arrays for gateway form factors, routing, QoS and order details.
Gateway hardware is the documented deviceType enum; the conditional prose misspelling hareware is normalized to hardware.
Prepaid billing defaults activate required cycle inputs. Inline gateway activation preserves the documented string dhcpDisable=false default.
The time-range requirements reference time_from/time_till while declared inputs are startTime/endTime; help retains the evidence and the server validates the alternative range forms.
response_notes: All operations use the explicit 800-success/900-failure response contract; pricing also requires returnObj.isSucceed=true.
Five malformed responses are normalized through punctuation repairs only; all original values remain captured.
The topology and gateway detail APIs publish arrays even for an exact input; no singleton result assumption is introduced.
API 5925 table metadata preserves the captured LTE_type spelling instead of adding a duplicate LTEType schema column.
